postal_system.full_code_format: JE plus one digit and an optional alphanumeric outward character, one inward digit and two letters; normally displayed with one space before the final three characters
postal_system.assignment_rule: A current Jersey unit postcode is a Jersey Post and Royal Mail routing assignment. Syntax, an ONSPD row, a JSearch point, a placeholder coordinate, a parish or another government boundary does not prove a Polygon/MultiPolygon for the unit postcode.
postal_system.normalization_rule: Trim, uppercase, remove internal whitespace for validation, require ^JE\d[A-Z\d]?\d[A-Z]{2}$, then display one space before the final three characters. Preserve the code as text. Normalization does not prove that the code is live, geographic or eligible for an area.
postal_system.full_code_geometry_rule: Serve an exact unit-postcode surface only from an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon explicitly related to that current unit code. Never buffer, Voronoi-partition, dissolve or relabel a JSearch point, ONSPD placeholder, address, delivery route, PO box, organisation, parish, building or land parcel into a postcode polygon.
postal_system.broader_context_geometry_rule: A postal-district, sector or outward-code context surface may be served only from a complete authoritative or rights-cleared real postal-boundary release with deterministic current unit-code membership, edition, date, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions, terms and SHA-256. It must be labelled as broader postal context and never as the exact searched unit-postcode geometry.
postal_system.po_box_route_organization_rule: Non-geographic, large-user, PO-box, route and organisation codes remain non-area. Every record requires source-defined classification; text shape alone is not enough to infer an area.
postal_system.jsearch_rule: The observed government JSearchSept2023 postcode layer contains 1,914 point records and no polygons. It is incomplete against the May 2026 live ONSPD denominator, contains terminated and non-matching values, and exposes blank licence/access fields. It is search evidence only and cannot be promoted, buffered, redistributed or served as a postcode surface.
postal_system.onspd_rule: The May 2026 ONSPD provides 3,215 live and 459 terminated Jersey unit-code records, all with GRIDIND 9, null eastings/northings, documented Channel Islands coordinate sentinels and no returned geometry. OGL reuse rights do not create missing geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: A Jersey Post address-finder result, JSearch point or ONSPD assignment is not permission to publish an address, recipient, occupant, delivery instruction or customer record. Address identity requires a separately authorised source and purpose.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building output requires an explicit rights-cleared relation from an address or postcode assignment to a building feature. Postcode membership, point proximity, point containment or shared text does not establish a building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Jersey parishes, vingtaines, electoral districts, census areas, roads and other administrative or service layers remain separate context. None may be relabelled as a unit-postcode, sector or outward-code perimeter.
postal_system.licence_rule: Every ONS, Jersey Post, Government of Jersey or other artifact pins provider, exact URL, capture time, edition/effective date, terms, attribution, scope, bytes and SHA-256. OGL-J applies only to qualifying information hosted on opendata.gov.je and does not automatically license an uncatalogued roadworks.gov.je service; ONS OGL reuse does not create geometry withheld for the Channel Islands; public finder access does not authorize bulk extraction, redistribution or API serving.
postal_system.territory_rule: The JE pack preserves Jersey identity. It does not merge Guernsey, the United Kingdom, the Isle of Man or another territory and does not treat ONS directory inclusion as a change in postal or territorial authority.

integration.postcode_flow: normalized JE unit postcode -> current rights-cleared assignment -> truthful exact non-area/unavailable reason or explicit unit surface -> separately labelled rights-cleared broader postal context when available -> explicit address/building relation from separate authority -> JE AGID cells
integration.coordinate_flow: honest no-coordinate result or competent source coordinate -> optional separately labelled postal context Polygon/MultiPolygon -> explicit address-to-building relation -> rights-cleared building -> JE AGID cell
integration.building_output_gate: current postcode or address identity plus an explicit source-defined rights-cleared building identifier/relation and exact building geometry

quality_gates.pass: Every code remains text, normalizes to the country grammar with one display space and distinguishes syntax from a live assignment.
The nationwide live JE unit-postcode denominator pins edition, effective date, update cadence, terms, coverage, exceptions, byte length and SHA-256.
Every displayed exact unit surface comes from an explicit competent Polygon/MultiPolygon relation; points, GRIDIND 9, null geometry and placeholder coordinates remain point/non-area or unavailable.
Every broader postal context comes from a complete authoritative or rights-cleared real postal-boundary release and is labelled separately from the searched unit code.

ONS, Jersey Post and Government of Jersey terms and attributions remain enforceable per artifact; public pages and uncatalogued services are never treated as bulk or public-serving authority without an explicit grant.
Postcode assignment, postal context area, search point, address, building, administration, occupancy and ownership remain distinct authorities and relations.
No resident, recipient, occupant, owner, rightsholder, personal contact, delivery instruction, title/value, credential or customer record is published.
Generic JE planning cells and synthetic fixtures verify behavior only and never satisfy production M2 evidence.

stages.definition: Country-specific contracts, authority separation and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current rights-cleared nationwide Jersey unit-postcode denominator and an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon explicitly corresponding to every searchable geographic unit postcode, or an honest source-defined non-area classification plus a separately labelled real outward-code, sector or district postal-context surface, are pinned by edition, effective date, terms, attribution, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions and SHA-256 and published as an approved immutable artifact. Searching a normalized JE postcode through the real AGID API/app must preserve unit versus broader-context grain, fit and render only the eligible surface with translucent fill and a clear outline, and show selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, confidence and any non-area reason. ONSPD GRIDIND 9 placeholders, null geometry, 99.999999 or rounded 100 latitude, longitude 0, JSearch points, addresses, routes, PO boxes, organisations, parishes, administrative areas, buffers, Voronoi cells, parcels/buildings and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2.
Complete rights-cleared address membership and coordinates pass derivation, topology, coverage, uncertainty and correction gates for explicitly derived postal context only.
Licensed address identity and exact rights-cleared building relationships pass identifier, privacy, CRS, coverage and redistribution gates.
